sql:
SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as num_trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, AVG(yt) as avg_yt, AVG(anglers) as avg_anglers
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 50
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC
LIMIT 30

SELECT report_date_doy, yt_all, wt_all, text
FROM fishdope
WHERE report_date_season = 2 AND report_date_doy >= 55
ORDER BY report_date_doy DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT ts_doy, ts_hour, AVG(wtmp_c) as temp_c
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 2 AND ts_doy >= 55
GROUP BY ts_doy, ts_hour
ORDER BY ts_doy DESC, ts_hour DESC
LIMIT 30
